{{Quote|It didn't take the ''Hakarans'' long to secure this platform&mdash;and they're already hunting down the stragglers.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="A Little Help on Hakara" />}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] embarked on a '''mission''' to the planet [[Hakara/Legends|Hakara]]. There, they helped the native [[Hakaran]]s fight off Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].
